notes: The printed 34.1s is the post hoc between-partner-condition mean difference; no standardized effect or numerical p/bound is printed for that comparison. Statistical significance alone was not converted into a p bound. Replication title and DOI verified against publisher metadata, but accessible material was abstract-only. Publisher full-text route returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex supplied no OA full text; targeted repository/preprint searches and author Academia profile supplied no accessible full text. No replication values or narrative verdict were extracted from the abstract.
